name: live-host-quiet-boundary
detail: The opted-in real Codex primary ran a host checkpoint to its park boundary, returned quiet exit 0, and left no watcher singleton.

name: live-host-attended-successors
detail: Two attended wakes from a real Codex primary reached main exactly once, each retained a live successor across acknowledgement, and the second host took over the previous cycle. Explicit stop succeeded.

name: live-host-predecessor-delivery
detail: Replacement activation after a real host KILL returned 1, reported forced-cleanup failure, retained the same watcher identity, and surfaced its delivered wake once.

name: live-host-preconfirmation-retirement
detail: Replacement activation after a real host KILL returned 1, reported forced-cleanup failure, retained the same watcher identity, and did not accept interrupted pre-beacon startup as healthy.
